capabilities.description: Maintain the product list for the shop, each product carrying stock on hand and its own reorder level, and expose it as an editable workbench table backed by persistent storage.
requirements: a product list with stock on hand and a reorder level per product

capabilities.description: Record a stock receipt and record a stock sale, each posted against a product and updating its stock on hand; reject non-positive quantities and sales that would drive stock negative.
requirements: record a stock receipt and a stock sale, each updating stock on hand

capabilities.description: Compute the low-stock report: list every product whose stock on hand is at or below its reorder level, showing the quantity to reorder for each.
requirements: a low-stock report listing every product at or below its reorder level

capabilities.description: Export the low-stock report as a spreadsheet file the shopkeeper can open in a spreadsheet program and save or print.
requirements: export that report as a spreadsheet

capabilities.description: Provide the one user role the shop needs (back-office operator) with no role matrix, no payments and no external integrations.
requirements: One user role, no payments, no integrations, no uploaded documents

drafting_note: inventory: 'product' is not on the declared-ready list (construction, finance, finance_ops, hotel_management, insurance, retail); the Store kit for this vertical is unverified — domain depth not guaranteed
summary: A deliberately small back-office tool for a single retail shop. It keeps a product list with stock on hand and a per-product reorder level, records stock receipts and stock sales that each adjust stock on hand, produces a low-stock report listing every product at or below its reorder level together with the quantity to reorder, and lets the shopkeeper export that report as a spreadsheet.
